name: Garlic
siboNotes: Garlic is extremely high in fructans and should be completely avoided during SIBO treatment. Even one clove (3g) is high FODMAP. Garlic powder is also high FODMAP. However, GARLIC-INFUSED OIL is safe because fructans are water-soluble but not oil-soluble - the flavor transfers but the FODMAPs don't.
preparationTips: Use garlic-infused olive oil for flavor without FODMAPs
Remove garlic after infusing and discard
Garlic scapes (green tops) are low FODMAP
Asafoetida can provide similar depth of flavor
